author: The Current
description:
Watch Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles perform "Get Still" at The Fitzgerald Theater
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Alan Sparhawk joined forces with fellow Duluth band Trampled by Turtles on a new album, called 'Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles,' released May 30, 2025. The collaboration was a project born organically out of support and friendship, as Sparhawk navigated loss and grief. 

Alan Sparhawk and Trampled by Turtles celebrated their 2025 collaborative album with a heartfelt performance at the Fitzgerald Theater in St. Paul on Dec. 11, 2025. The Current captured the entire show on video and will release it in full on Friday, May 29, to mark the one-year anniversary of ‘Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles.’ Watch a performance of "Get Still" above.

Musicians
Alan Sparhawk – vocals, guitar 
Dave Simonett – guitar, lead vocals, harmonica
Tim Saxhaug – bass, backing vocals
Dave Carroll – banjo, backing vocals
Erik Berr
title: Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles — Get Still (live at The Fitzgerald Theater)

author: The Current
description:
Watch Alan Sparhawk and Trampled by Turtles perform "Get Still" at the Fitzgerald Theater
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Alan Sparhawk and Trampled by Turtles celebrated their 2025 collaborative album with a heartfelt performance at the Fitzgerald Theater in St. Paul on Dec. 11, 2025. The Current captured the entire show on video and released it in full on Friday, May 29, to mark the one-year anniversary of ‘Alan Sparhawk with Trampled by Turtles,’ available on @subpop Records.

Here’s “Get Still” from the performance, which integrates Sparhawk’s vocoder-enhanced singing with Trampled by Turtles’ acoustic instrumentation and no-effects backing vocals. 

Follow The Current on YouTube to experience this special night.

Musicians @AlanSparhawkofLow & @tbtduluth 
Alan Sparhawk – vocals, guitar
Dave Simonett – guitar, lead vocals, harmonica
Tim Saxhaug – bass, backing vocals
Dave Carroll – banjo, backing vocals
Erik Berry – mandolin, backing
title: Alan Sparhawk and Trampled by Turtles perform "Get Still"
